entries.label: Amethyst Rhinestone
cells: Meal cooking is 1.5x faster. This bonus is applied TWICE if all 3 purple jewels are active.

entries.label: Black Diamond Rhinestone
cells: All meals now give a 1.16x higher bonus! Go ahead and check it out at the Dinner Menu! Doesn't apply to the meal that gives Line Width bonus.

entries.label: Black Diamond Ulthurite
cells: 'Unadulterated Banking Fury' gives an additional +1% Total Damage per greened stack.

entries.label: Deadly Wrath Jewel
cells: +50% extra Deathbringer Bones. This bonus always has a 100px connection range no matter what!

entries.label: Emerald Navette
cells: All players have 200 higher base efficiency in all skills, and +10% skill action speed. This bonus is applied TWICE if all 5 Green Jewels are active.

entries.label: Emerald Pyramite
cells: Meal cooking is 1% faster for every 25 total upgrade levels across all kitchens.

entries.label: Emerald Rhinestone
cells: 28% reduced incubation egg time. Mo eggs mo problems tho, fo sho.

entries.label: Emerald Rhombol
cells: 'Fungi Finger Pocketer' mainframe bonus gives an additional +1% cash bonus per million mushroom kills

entries.label: Emerald Ulthurite
cells: Shiny Mobs in the Fenceyard level up their Passive Bonuses +30% faster

entries.label: Eternal Energy Jewel
cells: +50% extra Arcane Cultist Tachyons. This bonus always has a 100px connection range no matter what!

entries.label: North Winds Jewel
cells: +50% extra Windwalker Dust. This bonus always has a 100px connection range no matter what!

entries.label: Pure Opal Navette
cells: +10% higher effects from all active bonuses and jewels within the Mainframe, except for Spelunker Obol. This is a multiplier, so +10% would be 1.10x, ya feel me? This bonus always has a 80px connection range no matter what!

entries.label: Pure Opal Rhinestone
cells: 'Slab Sovereignty' gives an additional 20% boost to all Slab Bonuses!

entries.label: Pure Opal Rhombol
cells: 'Depot Studies PhD' gives an additional 10% boost to all Crop Depot bonuses!

entries.label: Purple Navette
cells: 'Animal Farm' mainframe bonus gives an additional +0.5% per species. If Animal Farm is not active, then this does nothing.

entries.label: Purple Rhombol
cells: All players get +40% Lab EXP gain.

entries.label: Pyrite Navette
cells: All players get 3x 'non-consume' chance, and raises the max chance from 90% to 98%, allowing for longer AFK with food.

entries.label: Pyrite Pyramite
cells: All players deal 1.10x more damage. This bonus is applied TWICE if all 4 Orange Jewels are active.

entries.label: Pyrite Rhinestone
cells: 'No Bubble Left Behind' mainframe bonus gives +2 levels instead of +1, and does so for the lowest 4 bubbles instead of 3.

entries.label: Pyrite Rhombol
cells: All mainframe bonuses and jewels have a 30% larger connection range, except for this jewel. This jewel has an 80px connection range no matter what!

entries.label: Sapphire Navette
cells: All players get +3% All Stat. STR, AGI, WIS, and LUCK to boot.

entries.label: Sapphire Pyramite
cells: Every 24 hours, the 2 lowest level Kitchen Upgrades across all owned kitchens gain +1 Lv.

entries.label: Sapphire Rhinestone
cells: Construction slot 1 is now trimmed up, and has 3x building Speed. Also trims slot 2 if all 4 blue jewels are active.

entries.label: Sapphire Rhombol
cells: Even if this jewel is off, all players within a 150px radius of this jewel, shown by the circle, have +25% Line Width. Also gives +25% Breeding EXP, but only when active.

pageProps.seoDescription: Every one of the 24 lab jewels in Legends of Idleon, and what each one connects to.
